summary: Giovanni Verardi is a scholar in history, archaeology, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied at the University of Allahabad, Banaras Hindu University, and Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University, and held a post at Kyoto University.

Girindrasekhar Bose worked in philosophy and other fields, studying at Presidency University, Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata, and the University of Calcutta. He held posts at the Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata (1911-1915) and the University of Calcutta (1917-1949).
Gisho Nakano was an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo. He held positions at Kyushu University (~1926-1952) and Koyasan University (~1952-1965).
Giuliana Martini is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology. In 2010, she held posts at both the Italian School of East Asian Studies and Kyoto University.

Giuseppe Bardelli worked in Indology and linguistics, studying under Giuseppe Caspar Mezzofanti, Eugène Burnouf, and Stanislas Julien. He served as Dozent for Coptic and Sanskrit at the University of Pisa (~1845-1865).
Giuseppe Caspar Mezzofanti was a linguist who studied at the University of Bologna from ~1789 to 1797. He subsequently held a post there from ~1797 to 1831.

Giuseppe Tucci worked in Tibetology, Indology, and Buddhist studies, studying at Sapienza University of Rome, University of Calcutta, and Visva-Bharati University. He held posts at Calcutta, Sapienza (~1932-1969), and the Istituto Italiano per il Medio ed Estremo Oriente.

Giuseppe Vignato works in history, archaeology, Buddhist studies, and Sinology. He completed doctoral studies at Peking University under Angela Falco Howard, Li Chongfeng, Su Bai, and Shichang Ma, and held a post there (attested 2017).

Giyu Nishi specialized in Buddhist studies, studying at the University of Tokyo under Sylvain Lévi, Taiken Kimura, and others. He held academic posts at the University of Tokyo (1926) and Toyo University (from 1927).
Gnanawimala Chandima is a scholar in Buddhist studies who studied at Nava Nalanda Mahavihara under Uma Shankar Vyas.
Godabarish Mishra was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He studied at Ravenshaw College (~1906-1910) and the University of Calcutta (~1910-1912), and served as Director at the University of Madras.

Gombojab Tsybikov was a Tibetology and Iranian and Central Asian studies scholar. He studied at Tomsk State University and Saint Petersburg State University, and served as Lecturer of the Mongolian Language at Far Eastern Federal University (~1902-1917).

Gopinath Kaviraj worked in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. He studied at the University of Allahabad (~1910-1914) and served as Professor of Tantra-Śāstra at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (~1964-1976).

Gordon D. Kaufman was a scholar of religious studies and philosophy. He studied at Northwestern University (~1947-1948) and Yale Divinity School (~1953-1955), and held a faculty post at Harvard University (~1963-1995).
Gordon Johnson is an Indologist and historian. He studied at Trinity College, Cambridge (~1961-1967) and held a post at the University of Cambridge (attested 2012).
Gottfried Hermann was a scholar of linguistics who studied at Leipzig University (~1786-1793) and the University of Jena (~1793-1794). He held a post at Leipzig University from ~1798 to 1848.

Gottlieb Siegfried Bayer worked in Sinology, history, and archaeology. He studied at the University of Königsberg under Christoph Theodosius Walther and held posts at Königsberg, Kathedralschule zu Königsberg, and the Russian Academy of Sciences (1726).

Gottlieb Wilhelm Leitner was a scholar of linguistics and Indology. He studied at King's College London in 1858, held a post there in 1861, and later worked at the Oriental Institute, Woking (~1884-1899).

Govind Chandra Pande worked in Indology, Buddhist studies, and history/archaeology. He served as Vice Chancellor at the University of Rajasthan and University of Allahabad, and chaired the Allahabad Museum and Indian Institute of Advanced Study.

Govind Sadashiv Ghurye was an Indologist who studied at Elphinstone College and earned his PhD at the University of Cambridge under W. H. R. Rivers. He held a post at the University of Mumbai from ~1924 to 1959.
